brief:
Aber Kawas has become the first Palestinian American elected to the New York State Legislature, according to Middle East Eye. Kawas is also the first woman wearing a hijab to be elected to office in the state legislature.

The election marks a milestone for Palestinian American political representation in New York, where Palestinians have long sought a voice in state government.

title: Aber Kawas elected first Palestinian American to New York State Legislature
